To combat climate change, it is essential to educate and raise awareness among as many people as possible—a goal that cannot be achieved through mere argumentation or debate. Most importantly, individuals associated with politicians often merely incite people to fight amongst themselves over issues of caste, religion, and national borders. If the government does not acknowledge this reality, then the administration of every country must, first and foremost, impose a complete ban on the felling of trees; only after that should we address our methods of air conditioning and the use of fossil fuels.
